content: Low-res render target pixel art suffers 'pixel crawl/shimmer' when the camera moves sub-texel: standard fix is snapping camera translation to a view-aligned texel-sized grid then shifting output back by the snap error (orthographic only; perspective has depth-dependent drift, no perfect snap — davidhol.land 3D pixel art rendering; Texel Splatting arXiv 2603.14587). Continuous small camera motion (sway/lean/FOV kick) makes every edge in a nearest-filtered target flicker constantly.
